name: MC
text: Suit cuffs pinched my wrists from a long day at work. A deep ache, originating at the small of my back, ascended each floor of my spine to my head.

name: MC
text: But as I passed the threshold into the dizzying world of pachinko, none of that mattered anymore.

name: MC
text: W-wow...! I can't believe how many games there are.

name: Old Woman
text: Heh. Never been to pachinko before, have you?

name: MC
text: I hadn't thought of it. Are you the manager? How do I play?

name: Bum
text: Nooooo! That was my entire salary, dammit! Guess it's time to sell the house and divorce my wire- hell, I'll sell the kittens too.

name: Old Woman
text: Don’t pay him any mind. If you’re a lucky cat like me, then you have nothing to fear.

name: Bum
text: I heard that, you heartless feline! I may not have found the secret yet, but I know you’re cheating somehow.

name: Old Woman
text: So, you don’t know how to play, right? Here, have a go at my favorite game.

name: Narrator
text: The old woman handed my a cup full of steel balls.
